ZH: 您的避难所需要稳定的\n电力、食物和水来维持运行。

ZH: 房间里的居民会自动和灾害斗争。\n居民在和灾害斗争的时候会损失生命值。\n如果居民失败了，灾害会蔓延到邻近的房间。

ZH: 提示：将居民拖进或者拖出受到灾害的房间来保证他们的存活。

ZH: 提示：将居民拖进或者拖出受到灾害的房间来保证他们的存活。

ZH: 灾害会在极速模式失败的房间或者是随机任何一个房间出现。

ZH: 提示：当电力不足时，可以分配属性更高的居民去发电室，或者点击极速模式。

ZH: 升级您的生产房间来生产更多的资源。点击右上角的箭头图标来升级房间。

ZH: 合并的房间能容纳更多的居民，从而生产更多的资源。

EN: Build additional storage rooms or upgrade your existing storage rooms to get more space.
ZH: 建造更多的储藏室或者升级现有的储藏室来获得更多的储藏空间。

ZH: 选中居民即可打开居民信息面板，为居民配备武器和装备，或者使用消辐宁和治疗针。

医疗补给

ZH: 提示：一些宠物可以成为居民探索废土时的绝佳伙伴。

Find Junk in Lunchboxes and in the Wasteland.

Upgrade your Workshops to craft Rare and Legendary items.
ZH:
在午餐盒和废土中寻找杂物。

Your Vault is on top of a valuable mineral called Ultracite.

您的避难所建立在一种名为辐射极琉矿的珍贵矿物之上。

辐尸人正在前来袭击您的避难所！

ZH: 看！{新居民}已出现在{避难所大门}。

EN: You can see the {DWELLER'S SPECIAL} stats. This info tells you where a {DWELLER} can be used most effectively.
ZH: 您可以看到{居民的SPECIAL属性}统计。这个信息告诉您{居民}在哪儿能被最有效地利用。

EN: To assign a {DWELLER}, {TAP} and {HOLD} on the Dweller and then {DRAG} them to a room. Try assigning this {DWELLER} to the {POWER GENERATOR} room you just built.
ZH: 要派遣一个{居民}，{点击}并{按住}居民，然后将他们{拖拽}到一个房间。试试将这个{居民}分配到您刚刚建好的{发电室}里。

ZH: 要派遣一个{居民}，{点击}并{按住}居民，然后将他们{拖拽}到一个房间。试试将这个{居民}分配到您刚刚建好的{发电室}里。

EN: To assign a {SELECTED DWELLER}, {HOLD} [A] to grab them and then {SELECT} a room. Try assigning this {DWELLER} to the {POWER GENERATOR} room you just built.
ZH: 要分配一个{选中的居民}，{按住}抓住居民，然后{选择}一个房间。试着将这个{居民}分配到刚才所建的{发电室}。

EN: Now assign the second {DWELLER} to the {POWER GENERATOR}. Remember to {TAP} and {HOLD} and then {DRAG} the {DWELLER} to the room.
ZH: 现在将第二个{居民}分配到{发电室}。记得{点击}和{按住}居民，然后{拖}到房间。

EN: Now assign the second {DWELLER} to the {POWER GENERATOR}. Remember to {CLICK} and {HOLD} and then {DRAG} the {DWELLER} to the room.
ZH: 现在将第二个{居民}分配到{发电室}。记得{点击}和{按住}居民，然后{拖}到房间。

EN: Now assign the second {DWELLER} to the {POWER GENERATOR}. Remember to {MOVE} to the {WASTELAND} and then {HOLD} [A] to grab them.
ZH: 现在将第二个{居民}分配到{发电室}。记得{移动}至{废土}，然后{按住}来拖住他们。

EN: Now that {DWELLERS} are working, the room will start {PRODUCING RESOURCES}. {DOUBLE TAP} on a {ROOM} to take a closer look.
ZH: 现在，{居民}正在工作，房间将开始{生产资源}。{双击}{房间}来仔细察看。

EN: Now that {DWELLERS} are working, the room will start {PRODUCING RESOURCES}. {DOUBLE CLICK} on a {ROOM} to take a closer look.
ZH: 现在，{居民}正在工作，房间将开始{生产资源}。{双击}{房间}来仔细察看。

EN: Now that {DWELLERS} are working, the room will start {PRODUCING RESOURCES}. {HOLD} [RT] to zoom in for a closer look.
ZH: 现在，{居民}正在工作，房间将开始{生产资源}。{按住}来放大仔细察看。

EN: If you are in dire need of extra resources, you can use the {RUSH MODE}. {TAP} the {RUSH BUTTON} to {OPEN} the {RUSH MENU}.
ZH: 如果需要额外资源，可以使用{极速模式}。{点击}{极速按钮}来{打开}{极速菜单}。

EN: If you are in dire need of extra resources, you can use the {RUSH MODE}. {CLICK} the {RUSH BUTTON} to {OPEN} the {RUSH MENU}.

EN: If you are in dire need of extra resources, you can use the {RUSH MODE}. Press [DU] to {OPEN} the {RUSH MENU}.
ZH: 如果需要额外资源，可以使用{极速模式}。按下来{打开}{极速菜单}。

EN: Activating Rush instantly produce {RESOURCES} and also {AWARDS} you {CAPS}. Although be careful, destructive {INCIDENTS} might happen.
ZH: 极速模式可立即产生{资源}，并{奖励}您{瓶盖}。但请小心，破坏性的{事件}也可能发生。

EN: Great! You've successfully completed your first Rush and collected {CAPS}.
ZH: 太好了！您已经成功完成了第一次极速模式，并收集到{瓶盖}。

EN: Now {TAP} on the {RESOURCE ICON} to {COLLECT} the resources and {RESTART ROOM PRODUCTION}.
ZH: 现在{点击}{资源图标}来{收集}资源和{重新启动房间生产}。

EN: Now {CLICK} on the {RESOURCE ICON} to {COLLECT} the resources and {RESTART ROOM PRODUCTION}.
ZH: 现在{点击}{资源图标}来{收集}资源和{重新启动房间生产}。

EN: Now press [A] to {COLLECT} the resources and {RESTART ROOM PRODUCTION}.
ZH: 现在按下来{收集}资源和{重新启动房间生产}。

EN: Each {WEEK}, {VAULT-TEC} will inspect your Vault and give you a rating based on your performance.
ZH: 每{周}，{避难所科技}会检查您的避难所，根据您的表现来给您一个评级。

EN: Congratulations! You've earned your first {REWARD} - a {LUNCH BOX} filled with goodies.
ZH: 恭喜您！您已经获得了您的第一个{奖励}——一个{午餐盒}。里面有很多好东西。

EN: Complete Vault-Tec {OBJECTIVES} to earn {CAPS} and {INCREASE} your {VAULT-TEC RATING}.
ZH: 完成避难所科技制定的{目标}来赚取{瓶盖}并{提升}您的{避难所评级}。

EN: {ADD FRIENDS} to {VISIT} and look at their {VAULT} and {COLLECT CAPS}.
ZH: {增加朋友}来{访问}并查看他们的{避难所}并{收集瓶盖}。

EN: Send {DWELLERS} to the {WASTELAND} to collect {CAPS}, {OUTFITS} and {WEAPONS}.
ZH: 将您的{居民}派遣到{废土}上来收集{瓶盖}，{装备}和{武器}。

EN: The {RADIO STUDIO} attracts Dwellers from the Wasteland and boosts {DWELLER HAPPINESS} in the Vault.
ZH: 您的{广播室}会吸引废土上的居民，并提升避难所内的{居民幸福度}。

EN: Here you can see and manage all the {WEAPONS} and {OUTFITS} you currently own.
ZH: 在这里您可以看到并管理您现在所拥有的全部{武器}和{装备}。

EN: {TRAIN} your Dwellers to {INCREASE} their {SPECIAL} stats.
ZH: {训练}您的居民，{增加}他们的{S.P.E.C.I.A.L.}属性。

EN: {MALE} and {FEMALE} Dwellers within the {LIVING QUARTERS} have a chance of making {BABIES}.
ZH: {男性}和{女性}居民如果共同待在{宿舍}里，会有一定生{小孩}的可能。

EN: {DESTROY ROCKS} to {EXPAND} your {VAULT} deeper.
ZH: {摧毁岩石}来向更深处{扩张}您的{避难所}。

EN: {STORAGE} Rooms expand your {VAULT INVENTORY}.
ZH: {储藏}室能扩大您的{避难所库存}。

EN: Rooms require {POWER} to function. Tap again to {CONFIRM}.
ZH: 房间需要{电力}才能运行。再次点击来{确认}。

EN: Rooms require {POWER} to function. Click again to {CONFIRM}.
ZH: 房间需要{电力}才能运行。再次点击来{确认}。

EN: Rooms require {POWER} to function. Press [A] again to {CONFIRM}.
ZH: 房间需要{电力}才能运行。按下来{确认}。

EN: Now that you know the basic rules of the Overseer role, keep expanding your Vault. Just remember to keep your Dwellers alive and happy. Good luck!
ZH: 现在您已经知道作为监督者的基本规则，请继续扩张您的避难所。请记住，要让您的居民活着，并且活得开心。祝您好运！

EN: Click on the {NUKA CAPS} to open your {LUNCHBOX MENU}.
ZH: 点击{核子瓶盖}来打开您的{午餐盒菜单}。

EN: Select the {LUNCHBOX ICON} in the {PIP-BOY} to open your {LUNCHBOX MENU}.
ZH: 选择{哔哔小子}里的{午餐盒图标}来打开{午餐盒菜单}。

EN: Look! {MORE DWELLERS} have shown up at the {VAULT DOOR}.
ZH: 看！{更多的居民}出现在了{避难所门口}。

EN: Make sure you equip your {DWELLERS} before sending them out to explore the {WASTELAND}. This will increase their chance of survival.
ZH: 请确认已经给您的{居民}配好了武器装备之后再将他们送去{废土}。这将会提高他们存活的概率。

EN: {BUILD} an {ELEVATOR} to gain access to the next floor.
ZH: {建造}一部{电梯}来连通下一楼层。

EN: Remember to {DESTROY} a rock before you {BUILD} a {ROOM}.
ZH: 记住在{建造}{房间}前请先{摧毁}岩石。

EN: No more space available for construction! {DESTROY} the {ROCK} that is blocking the room in order to proceed.
ZH: 没有足够的建造空间！请{摧毁}挡住房间的{岩石}来继续建造。

EN: {DESTROY} the rock that is blocking the elevator in order to access the next floor.
ZH: {摧毁}挡住电梯的岩石，才能进入下一层。

EN: Let's build a second {ROOM}.
ZH: 让我们来建造第二个{房间}。

EN: You need a {DINER}, which will produce {FOOD}. {TAP} on the {DINER}.
ZH: 需要一个{餐厅}来帮您生产{食物}。{点击}{餐厅}。

ZH: 需要一个{餐厅}来帮您生产{食物}。{选择}{餐厅}。

EN: Dwellers require {FOOD} to keep their {HEALTH} up. Tap again to {CONFIRM}.
ZH: 居民需要{食物}来保证他们的{生命值}。再次点击来{确认}。

ZH: {点击}{建造区域}来确认地点。

ZH: 让我们再建造一个房间。

EN: This time, you need a {WATER TREATMENT} room, which will produce {WATER}. {TAP} on {WATER TREATMENT}.
ZH: 这次您需要一个{水房}来帮助您生产干净的{水}。{点击}{水房}。
